sloka: एकं द्वे त्रीन् बहून् क्रुद्धो वानरान् सह राक्षसैः।समादायैकहस्तेन प्रचिक्षेप त्वरन् मुखे ।। ६.६७.९७ ।।
transliteration: ekaṁ dve trīn bahūn kruddho vānarān saha rākṣasaiḥ।samādāyaikahastena pracikṣepa tvaran mukhe ।। 6.67.97 ।।

translations.english: Taking one, two, three, and many Vanaras along with Rakshasas hastily with one hand he was gulping them.
